s.zh:
每过 8 小时就会有一波生物从裂口里涌出来，而且一波比一波多；开了 3 天还没关上的话，它会崩溃，一口气喷出双倍的生物。

关上它：打掉裂口（600 生命）。法师路径的殖民者攻击裂口时伤害 ×3；巨灵可以试着直接命令它关闭（只能试一次）。关上后会留下位面残渣，野兽也会安静下来。
s.en:
Every 8 hours a wave of creatures pours out of the rift, each wave bigger than the last; if it's still open after 3 days, it collapses, spewing out double the creatures at once.

Close it: destroy the rift (600 HP). Colonists on the wizard path deal ×3 damage when attacking the rift; a genie can try to command it shut directly (only one try). Closing it leaves planar residue, and the beasts calm down too.

s.zh: 殖民地外偶尔撕开一道位面裂口（九狱、元素火位面、妖精荒野、幽影界），每8小时涌出一波生物，3天不关会崩溃。打掉裂口或让巨灵命令都能关上。
s.en: A planar rift occasionally tears open outside the colony (the Nine Hells, the Elemental Plane of Fire, the Feywild, the Shadowfell), with a wave of creatures pouring out every 8 hours; it collapses if not closed in 3 days. Destroying the rift or a genie's command can close it.

s.zh: 一队饿着的巨人（余烬氏族的火巨人或食人魔一家、费伦拓荒同盟的泰坦或霜巨人战帮）路过扎营，会找你讨吃的，有可能有人想留下来。
s.en: A band of hungry giants (fire giants or an ogre family of the Ember Clan, titans or a frost giant war band of the Faerûn Frontier Alliance) passes by and camps, asking you for food; someone might want to stay.

s.zh: 黄昏之年
s.en: Year of Twilight

s.zh: 每年有25%概率出现“黄昏之兆”（第1年在第1～30天里随机一天，第2年起在每年第一天），15天后开始黄昏之年（最早第16天）：神力灌注者和神明附体的敌人大幅增多。关闭后不再触发（已经开始的照常结束）；平时的神力灌注不受影响。
s.en: Each year there's a 25% chance of "omens of twilight" (in year 1 on a random day in days 1-30, from year 2 on the first day of each year), and the twilight years begin 15 days later (earliest day 16): divinely infused and god-possessed enemies increase greatly. When off, it no longer triggers (ones already started end as usual); normal divine infusion is unaffected.
